newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to propose resuming U.S.-Korean war games.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to propose resuming U.S.-Korean war games.

text.p: South Korea will propose to the United States resuming joint Team Spirit war games scrapped last year as a gesture of peace to North Korea, a defence ministry statement said on Tuesday.
It said the move was in response to the incursion last week of a North Korean submarine.
Team Spirit military exercises were held each year since 1976. North Korea became increasingly critical of the games that it said were a rehearsal for an invasion.

The decision to scrap them was announced in February last year to improve the chances of implementating a landmark nuclear deal between the United States and North Korea under which Pyongyang agreed to scrap its suspected nuclear weapons programme.
"We believe it is inevitable to resume the Team Spirit exercises, which were suspended temporarily," the statement said.
The proposal to restart the war games would be made in a meeting in Washington next month of U.S. and South Korean defence ministers.
